title: 2260. Minimum Consecutive Cards to Pick Up

examples.explanation: We can pick up the cards [3,4,2,3] which contain a matching pair of cards with value 3. Note that picking up the cards [4,2,3,4] is also optimal.
There is no way to pick up a set of consecutive cards that contain a pair of matching cards.
